title_zh: 确认雨天旧车站室内导览和集合地点

scenario.label_zh: 确认雨天旧车站室内导览和集合地点
scenario.goal_zh: 核对导览形式、旧建筑名称及雨天安排，并确认集合时间地点

context_zh: 游客致电遗产中心，核对虚构旧车站参观活动的信息。
author: author-phase07-c

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.text: The forecast says rain all morning. Is tomorrow's station tour still going ahead?

sentences.speaker: Hassan
sentences.text: Yes. It takes place inside the former station building, so the rain will not change the route.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.text: What is the format? Is it mainly a talk, or do we walk around?

sentences.speaker: Hassan
sentences.text: It is a guided walk through three rooms, with short stops to look at photographs.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.text: My old map calls it the Eastgate Museum. Is that a different place?

sentences.speaker: Hassan
sentences.text: No. It was formerly known as the Eastgate Museum. It is now called the Station Heritage Centre.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.text: Good. Where should I meet the guide?

sentences.speaker: Hassan
sentences.text: Inside the main entrance at ten. The guide will be beside the old ticket window.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.text: Thank you. I will come to the main entrance just before ten.
